author: Shannon Ballew
title: Meet Georgia House District 23 candidates at Cherokee forum - NewsBreak
text:
By Shannon Ballew ,
14 hours ago The historic Cherokee County courthouse By Margaret Waage, File The Cherokee County Republican Women are hosting a candidate forum Nov. 11 in Canton, where voters are invited to hear from Republican candidates for State House District 23.
District 23 was formerly represented by state Rep. Mandi Ballinger, who died in October after a battle with cancer.
The State House District 23 special election is set for Dec. 9.
The district is in parts of Cherokee County, including Canton.
CCRW’s candidate forum is set for Nov. 11 in the courtroom on the second floor of the historic Cherokee County Courthouse, 100 North St. in downtown Canton. The event will start with a meet-and-greet with candidates from 5-5:50 p.m., followed by the forum from 6-7:30 p.m.
The forum offers voters to meet candidates and understand their positions on the issues.
All Republican candidates for State House District 23 are expected to participate, CCRW reports.
The event will follow CCRW’s established structure for candidate forums:
♦ Each candidate will deliver a two-minute opening statement.
♦ Questions will be posed by a member of the press.
♦ Audience members are invited to submit questions, which will be vetted for relevance and respectfulness. Per CCRW rules, approved questions must relate directly to the office being sought and will be asked of each candidate.
♦ Candidates will have two minutes to respond to each question. No rebuttals will be allowed.
♦ Each candidate will give a one-minute closing statement at the end of the forum.
All participants, including candidates and audience members, are asked to maintain a respectful atmosphere. Personal attacks will not be permitted.
